name: eClerx Services Ltd.
about: eClerx Services Limited provides business process management, change management, data-driven insights, and advanced analytics services in North America, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, and the Asia Pacific. It offers omnichannel customer support, customer journey mapping, quality monitoring, and field technical operations; digital marketing services, including omnichannel campaigns, creative production, product data management, MarTech enablement, search and media operations, and content and commerce services; and creative and content productions, such as photo/video management, post-production, 3D-CGI, VR/AR, digital workflows, and omnichannel delivery.
